request.query: What features most influence the assessment score for a new post? Rank them and explain.

assess_post.content: The system is rigged. Wake up, sheeple. Share to expose the truth. #StopTheSteal @BigBroccoli

response.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's broad "rigged system"/mass-awakening call ("Wake up, sheeple. Share to expose the truth") echoes the wording and framing of #WakeUpAmerica, which likewise warns readers not to "fall for tricks like this" [T4-004421](#T4-004421). Its "#StopTheSteal" election-fraud framing is thematically closer to the post amplifying an allegation that a Florida election worker is revealing "Massive Voter Fraud Happening Right Now" [T4-004732](#T4-004732), though that post reports/links a specific claim rather than issuing a general call to share. The remaining posts differ in target and subject: a direct accusation of lying aimed at @BarackObama [T4-003068](#T4-003068) and commentary on alleged "corruption in our justice system" prompted by a pundit's fear [T4-009173](#T4-009173) share only a diffuse distrust-of-institutions tone, while the prison-strike solidarity post [T4-003396](#T4-003396) shares nothing meaningful with the new post. Note that shared topics and slogans do not establish agreement, coordination, or that any stated claim is true.
